title: The Rescue
positive_prompt: A cinematic high-angle shot looking straight down into an ancient, mossy stone well. At the bottom, LEO, a plump stylized 3D lion with golden-yellow fur, floats in the clear water with an embarrassed expression; his once-fluffy orange mane is now dark, wet, and flattened against his head, and his tiny gold crown floats comically beside him. He wears a soaked royal red velvet cape with a gold embroidered border. At the top rim of the well, ROBBY, a cute cream-colored 3D rabbit with long ears, wearing a lime green button-up vest, a red silk bowtie, and a royal blue leather satchel across his shoulder, leans over the edge with a helpful expression, lowering a thick brown hemp rope. Bright morning sunlight streams down into the well, creating ethereal god-rays and sparkling reflections on the water's surface. Pixar-quality 3D animation, ultra-detailed fur textures (contrasting wet and dry fur), vibrant colors, soft cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field focusing on Leo, 8k resolution, highly polished render.
negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, watermark, logo, text, cropped, deformed, duplicate, bad anatomy, extra limbs, fluffy mane, dry fur on lion
